resources.string: The speech model is missing (Whisper, about 160 MB, only the first time) and it couldn\'t be downloaded because there is no connection. As soon as there is internet it is downloaded and transcription happens by itself. You can also download it now in Settings › Voice › “Download”, or import it there if you downloaded it on another device.
Waiting for the speech model: it will be transcribed as soon as there is internet. Settings › Voice › “Download”.
Could not set the timings: what is heard doesn\'t resemble the lyrics. Try “Sync the lyrics” by tapping.
Nothing can be heard to transcribe in this song.
The lyrics of “%1$s” now have their timings. Open them to review.
The lyrics are yours, as they were; the timings come from what is heard. Review them: you can accept them, keep editing or sync them by tapping.
No lyrics were pasted: this is what is heard, with its timings.
This song has no lyrics yet
First write or paste the lyrics
Tap “Mark” right when each line starts
This phone can\'t show the preview while recording: photos and clips are taken anyway (watch the counter).
Recording the screen; the audio continues separately
With the room video the screen is not recorded
Tap the clock: pause · Hold it: finish
Discard the recording? Everything recorded is deleted: the audio, the video, the photos and the screenshots.
What is said shows up here, sentence by sentence, with the Jev key and live listening turned on (Settings › Jev). Without it, the text still comes out when you finish.
What I am going to say
No topics. Put the list in “Meeting topics” before starting.
A single recording for the online class, the in-person one or the meeting

The audio is always recorded. While recording, the floating bar has: “Photo” (the camera), “Capture” (the screen instantly; hold to choose a piece), “Screen” (turns the screen video on or off; the audio continues) and “Clip”. Tap the clock to pause and hold it to finish.
You can turn it on or off whenever you want from the bar.
The whole video of the meeting with the back camera. With it the screen is not recorded.
